paragraphs.text: One was Wrenn 's first treefolk host, from Wrenn's own homeworld.

One was Wrenn's initial partner, a female treefolk who was her home and guide. The bond between Wrenn and One was profound and symbiotic, blending their essences into a unified existence that transcended mere physical partnership. One was the dryad 's first host, and she was led to her by her inner inferno while it was still new and bright. One was a tree whose song knew Wrenn's own, and they came together and were One. With One, Wrenn learned that those who have no roots to anchor them can walk as they will, not limited to a single Plane . When One was done serving her time as Wrenn's partner, Wrenn allowed her to take root on another, unnamed Plane. Wrenn then found another tree to sing with, which would become Two.
